purpose: Structural feasibility analysis of whether a published future month would actually unblock H10 (fresh sealed forward block, formations strictly after 2026-09-29, strict 30-day maturity, trailing-decile high/low classification). No network, no fabrication: computed from on-disk Binance kline panels only.
method: Reconstructed the px_wide index exactly as scripts/eval_forward_block.py does (outer-join of all 32 binance_klines_*.csv on date). last_allowed_formation = index_loc(data_cutoff) - forward_horizon_days (30). Fresh-block formations = index dates >= 2026-09-30 and <= last_allowed_formation. The trailing_window_outer_deciles state rule requires >=30 prior in-block dispersions, i.e. effectively >=31 formations, before any high/low state can be assigned (eval_forward_block.py:497).

observed_on_disk.october_2028_gap_scope: 2026-10-28 absent from ALL 30 active symbols' kline panels (EOSUSDT and MATICUSDT already delisted). A single missing day; it shifts last_allowed_formation by index position but does not change the month-count math.

current_state.verdict: IMMATURE / NULL_DIFF. Matches the committed forward_block_h10_fresh artifact exactly.

projection.caveat: Structural projection only, NOT a data claim about November 2026. Assumes Nov/Dec 2026 follow the same distribution.

cutoff_2026_11_30.note: FIRST cutoff that structurally could classify high/low

key_finding: October 2026 publication (already UNBLOCKED per cutoff_probe_20261103T022455Z.json) did NOT and could NOT unblock H10: at cutoff 2026-10-31 the fresh block window holds exactly 1 formation, and the state rule needs >=30 prior in-block dispersions. November 2026 is the first month whose publication would structurally change this (~31 formations projected). The durable state's earlier framing ('wait for the data vintage to mature') was therefore correct but imprecise: the gate is not 'any newer vintage' but specifically the November 2026 vintage.
does_not: validate, replace, or unlock the frozen confirmatory track (H1/H6/H7). No frozen artifact modified. Canonical H004V106 block byte-unchanged.
next_action: When the November 2026 Binance monthly archive publishes (both klines AND fundingRate HTTP 200, cutoff >= 2026-11-29), re-probe, refresh free data, re-run tests, verify H004V106 unchanged, then re-run the fresh sealed block into forward_block_h10_fresh/ and require n_high>0 AND n_low>0 before any confirmatory claim.
